clock: Active task elapsed time, including candidate enumeration, property checks, optimization, exact verification and I/O; queue wait excluded.
matrix_protocol: Enumerate all signed affine representatives with no rectangle-cost filter. Randomized order. Coverage at timeout is reported explicitly.
restart_protocol: First pass: one unrestricted field construction per legal matrix. If first pass finishes: integer unrestricted, field depth<=3, integer depth<=3 at seed0; then repeat all four arms at seeds1,2,...
baseline: Retain verified rectangle circuits; report heuristic-only and combined bounds separately.
infeasible: Four already-proved infeasible table cells are skipped, not freshly re-proved.
